convert.title: Convert Media
convert.jobCancelMessage: This will clear the current conversion job. Are you sure?
convert.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel the current conversion?
convert.hardwareAccelAlert: Hardware acceleration is enabled. Video encoding will use your GPU when compatible.
convert.inputFileHint: The source media file to convert. Common formats include MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, MP3, and WAV.
convert.dropLabel: Drop a media file here or click to browse
convert.outputFileHint: The destination path where the converted file will be saved.
convert.losslessCopyHint: Copies the streams without re-encoding. Fast and lossless, but requires the output container to support the source codecs.
convert.videoCodecHint: The codec used to encode the video stream, e.g. H.264, H.265, or VP9.
convert.audioCodecHint: The codec used to encode the audio stream, e.g. AAC, MP3, or Opus.
convert.videoBitrateHint: The target bitrate for the video stream. Higher values increase quality and file size. Auto keeps the source bitrate.
convert.audioBitrateHint: The target bitrate for the audio stream. Higher values increase quality and file size. Auto keeps the source bitrate.
convert.qscaleHint: Constant-quality scale from 1 (best quality, largest file) to 31 (worst quality, smallest file).
convert.scaleHint: Resizes the video to the given width and height, e.g. 1280x720. Empty keeps the original resolution.
convert.rotationHint: Rotates the output by 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise. Stream-copy mode applies rotation as lossless metadata for MP4, MOV and MKV outputs.
convert.mirrorHint: Flips the output horizontally (left/right) or vertically (top/bottom). Mirroring always re-encodes the video.
convert.rotateCopyMetadataNote: In lossless copy mode, rotation is stored as lossless metadata (no re-encode). Mirroring requires re-encoding.
convert.rotateCopyUnsupported: This rotation or mirror cannot be applied in lossless copy mode (only rotation to MP4, MOV or MKV supports metadata). Turn off lossless copy to re-encode.
convert.pixelFormatHint: The color format of the encoded video, e.g. yuv420p for 8-bit or yuv420p10le for 10-bit. Match the source for best compatibility.
convert.transcoderCoreHint: The engine used for the conversion. FFmpeg is the default and most compatible.
convert.encoderTypeHint: Overrides the encoder type chosen in Settings for this conversion. Automatic follows the value set in Settings.
convert.codecCompatWarning: The video codec {{codec}} may not be fully compatible with the .{{extension}} container. Suggested extension: .{{suggested}}
convert.filtersHint: Applies FFmpeg video filters (crop, frame rate, deinterlace, denoise, color...) during re-encoding. All filters merge into the single -vf chain after scale and rotation.
convert.customChainHint: Comma-separated FFmpeg filter expressions. Each entry must use balanced brackets, matched quotes, and no shell metacharacters.
convert.filtersDisabledNote: Video filters require re-encoding. Turn off lossless copy to add filters.
convert.filtersCopyWarning: Lossless copy mode is on, so video filters would be ignored. Turn off lossless copy to apply filters.

imageCompress.title: Compress Image
imageCompress.inputImageHint: The source image to compress. JPEG, PNG, WebP and BMP are supported.
imageCompress.outputFileHint: Where to save the compressed image. The extension follows the selected format.
imageCompress.outputFormatHint: The format the image is converted to. JPEG gives the smallest files, PNG is lossless.
imageCompress.qualityHint: Compression quality. Lower values give smaller files but more visible artifacts.
imageCompress.scaleHint: Output resolution preset. Pick a standard size or keep the original by selecting 'No scaling'.
imageCompress.keepAspectRatioHint: When enabled the image keeps its original proportions; when disabled it is stretched to the exact resolution.

audioExtract.title: Extract Audio
audioExtract.videoFileHint: The source video that contains the audio track you want to extract.
audioExtract.outputFileHint: The destination file where the extracted audio will be saved. Its extension matches the selected codec.
audioExtract.audioCodecHint: The codec used to encode the audio stream, e.g. AAC, MP3, or Opus.
audioExtract.bitrateHint: The target bitrate for the audio stream. Higher values increase quality and file size. Auto keeps the source bitrate.
audioExtract.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel the audio extraction?

videoCut.useDuration: Use duration instead of end time
videoCut.jobCancelMessage: This will clear the current video cut form. Are you sure?
videoCut.videoFileHint: Drag and drop a video file here or click to browse your computer.
videoCut.dropLabel: Drop a video file here or click to browse
videoCut.outputFileHint: The path where the trimmed video will be saved.
videoCut.startTimeHint: Where the cut segment begins. You can also drag the green trim handle on the timeline.
videoCut.durationHint: Instead of an end time, specify how long the cut segment should be.
videoCut.endTimeHint: Where the cut segment ends. You can also drag the red trim handle on the timeline.
videoCut.useDurationHint: Switch between an end time and a duration for the cut segment.
videoCut.cutHint: Start cutting the video using the configured start and end positions.
videoCut.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel the video cut? The form will be cleared.

videoTimeline.audioEnabledHint: Include the audio track in the cut output. Uncheck to produce a video without sound.

batchQueue.empty: Queue is empty. Add files to begin batch processing.
batchQueue.cancelAllMessage: This will cancel all queued and running jobs. Are you sure?
batchQueue.noResults: No jobs match the current filter or search
batchQueue.dropHint: Drop files to add them to the queue
batchQueue.skippedDuplicates: Skipped {{count}} file(s) - duplicate or unsupported for this operation
batchQueue.optionsEditableAlert: Options can still be changed while jobs are queued.
batchQueue.optionsLockedAlert: Options are locked while the batch is running.
batchQueue.optionsLocked: Options are locked while the batch is running
batchQueue.outputCollision: Another queued job already uses that output path.
batchQueue.outputCollisionSkipped: Skipped {{count}} job(s) - the new output would overwrite another job's file ({{names}})
batchQueue.optionsUpdateFailed: This job is no longer editable.
batchQueue.remuxContainerHint: The container the streams are copied into. Auto keeps each file's source extension.

settings.title: Settings
settings.alwaysOnTopHint: Keeps the app window above all other windows.
settings.launchAtLoginHint: Starts EncodeX automatically when you sign in to your computer.
settings.monitoringErrorReportingHint: Helps improve EncodeX by sending anonymous error reports. You can turn this off at any time.
settings.telemetryHint: Helps improve EncodeX by sending anonymous usage data and error reports. You can turn this off at any time.
settings.mcpServerHint: Lets external MCP clients such as Claude Desktop, VS Code, or Cursor control EncodeX over a local connection. The server listens only on this computer.
settings.mcpPortHint: Local TCP port for the MCP server (1024-65535). The app restarts the server when this changes.
settings.mcpTokenHint: Optional. When set, MCP clients must send this token as a Bearer credential. Leave empty to allow any local client.
settings.mcpEndpointHint: The URL MCP clients connect to. Add this address to your MCP client as the server URL.
settings.mcpAuthorizationHint: Clients must send this header as a Bearer credential on every request.
settings.hardwareAccelerationHint: Uses your GPU (NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF) for video encoding and decoding. Turn off for software-only encoding.
settings.hwaccelModeHint: Automatic: the GPU does both decoding and encoding (fastest, not always compatible). Encode only: the GPU encodes and the CPU decodes (safest).
settings.encoderTypeHint: Filters the video codec list. Automatic shows all available encoders, Hardware shows GPU encoders only, Software shows CPU encoders only.

about.title: About EncodeX
about.subtitle: A free and open-source multimedia toolkit built on FFmpeg. Convert, inspect, compress, extract, cut, and batch-process audio, video, and images — all in one place.
about.description: EncodeX is a cross-platform multimedia toolkit that brings the power of FFmpeg to a modern, intuitive desktop interface. Convert audio, video, and images between formats with granular control over codecs, bitrate, resolution, pixel format, and quality; stream-copy tracks losslessly for instant remuxing; extract audio from video; and cut video with a frame-accurate preview player. Hardware-accelerated encoding is supported across NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF, VAAPI, Apple VideoToolbox, and Microsoft Media Foundation, with available encoder families auto-detected from the bundled FFmpeg binary at runtime. Batch jobs run through a persistent queue with real-time progress, and a headless CLI mode exposes the same capabilities for scripting and automation.

presets.cropHint: Crops the video to the given width, height and offset.
presets.framerateHint: Changes the output frame rate (frames are duplicated or dropped).
presets.colorHint: Adjusts brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma (eq).
presets.grayscaleHint: Removes color, leaving a black & white image.
presets.blurHint: Applies a box blur to soften the image.

remux.title: Remux
remux.dropLabel: Drop a video file here or click to browse
remux.videoFileHint: The source media file whose streams will be repackaged into the target container. Streams are copied without re-encoding.
remux.containerHint: The output container for the remuxed file. Choose from common video containers; the output extension follows the container.
remux.streamsHint: Choose which streams from the source file to keep in the remuxed output. Unchecked streams are dropped.
remux.audioSyncHint: Shift the primary audio track relative to video without re-encoding, e.g. -0.5 for 0.5s earlier or 1.5 for 1.5s later.
remux.audioSyncLossless: Lossless: the audio is stream-copied with a timestamp offset, so quality is unchanged.
remux.subtitlesHint: External subtitle files (.srt, .ass, .vtt) embedded into the remuxed output as extra input tracks.
remux.subtitleCodecHint: The subtitle codec used for the embedded track. Containers accept different subtitle formats; picking one the container cannot store surfaces a warning.
remux.audioTracksHint: External audio files (.m4a, .aac, .mp3, .flac, .opus, .ogg, .wav) embedded into the remuxed output as extra input tracks.
remux.addedTrackDelayHint: Signed offset applied to this track relative to the video (positive = plays later). Lossless: applied as -itsoffset with stream copy.
remux.thumbnailHint: Optional cover image (.jpg, .jpeg, .png) embedded into the remuxed file. MKV/WebM attach it as an attached picture stream; MP4/MOV embed it as a video stream with an attached_pic disposition.
remux.thumbnailUnsupported: {{container}} cannot store cover art. Switch to MKV, WebM, MP4, or MOV to attach a thumbnail.
remux.chaptersHint: Source chapters are preserved by default. Import an FFMETADATA chapters file to replace the source chapters in the remuxed file.
remux.copyChaptersHint: Preserves the source file's chapter markers in the remuxed output (lossless, -map_chapters 0).
remux.chaptersUnsupported: {{container}} does not store chapter metadata; chapters will be dropped.
remux.warningsHint: Non-blocking findings about whether the selected streams and settings fit the chosen container. Warning-level findings still allow starting; error-level findings block it.
remux.outputFileHint: The destination path for the remuxed file. Its extension follows the target container.
remux.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel the current remux?
remux.filtersHint: Applies FFmpeg video filters while the selected video streams are re-encoded. Filters cannot be applied to a lossless copy, so adding one turns the remux into a re-encode.
remux.filtersReencodeWarning: Video filters cannot run on a stream copy, so the {{count}} selected filter(s) turn this remux into a re-encode.

demux.title: Demux
demux.videoFileHint: The source media file whose streams will be extracted. Each selected stream is written to its own output file.
demux.dropLabel: Drop a video file here or click to browse
demux.streamsHint: Choose which streams to extract. Each checked stream becomes its own output file; unchecked streams are skipped.
demux.videoContainerHint: How the video streams are written. Copy extracts them losslessly without re-encoding; choosing a container re-encodes the video into that format.
demux.audioCodecHint: How the audio streams are written. Copy extracts them losslessly without re-encoding; choosing a codec re-encodes the audio.
demux.subtitleFormatHint: How the subtitle streams are written. Copy extracts them losslessly without re-encoding; choosing a format converts the subtitles. Bitmap subtitles (e.g. PGS/DVDSUB) cannot become plain text and stay copied.
demux.subtitleWarningHint: Bitmap subtitle streams (e.g. PGS/DVDSUB) cannot be re-encoded into a plain-text format without OCR, so they are extracted as .mks stream copies instead. They show as Copy in the extraction plan.
demux.bitmapSubtitleWarning: This bitmap subtitle stream cannot be re-encoded into a plain-text format without OCR, so it is extracted as a .mks stream copy instead.
demux.outputDirHint: The folder where the extracted streams are written. Defaults to the source file's folder.
demux.summaryHint: One output file per checked stream, in the order they run. Files marked Copy are extracted losslessly; files marked Convert are re-encoded.
demux.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel the current demux?
demux.filtersHint: Applies FFmpeg video filters (crop, frame rate, deinterlace, denoise, color...) while the selected video streams are re-encoded. Copy is lossless, so filters only appear when a video target container re-encodes the video.
demux.filtersIgnoredCopy: Video filters are ignored while the video target is Copy, because a stream copy cannot re-encode. Choose a video target container to apply them.
